knowledgePoints.title: 一、定语从句的定义
knowledgePoints.content: 定语从句是在复合句中修饰名词或代词的从句，相当于形容词的作用。分为限制性和非限制性定语从句。

subPoints.title: 限制性定语从句
subPoints.content:
对先行词起限定修饰作用，从句与主句之间没有逗号。
He is a teacher who works at our school.

subPoints.title: 非限制性定语从句
subPoints.content:
对先行词起补充说明作用，从句与主句之间有逗号隔开。
Beijing, which is the capital of China, is a beautiful city.

knowledgePoints.title: 二、先行词与关系词
knowledgePoints.content: 先行词是被定语从句所修饰的名词或代词；关系词引导定语从句，包括关系代词和关系副词。

subPoints.title: 关系代词
subPoints.content:
that, which, who, whom, whose, as
关系代词在从句中作主语、宾语或定语

subPoints.title: 关系副词
subPoints.content:
when, where, why
关系副词在从句中作时间、地点、原因状语

knowledgePoints.title: 三、that与which的区别
knowledgePoints.content: 在指代物时，that与which的用法区别

subPoints.title: 只能用which的情况
subPoints.content:
1) 非限制性定语从句中
2) 介词之后作宾语
3) 先行词是that或从句中套从句，另一个用which

subPoints.title: 只能用that的情况
subPoints.content:
1) 先行词是不定代词
2) 先行词被all, every, no, some, little, much等修饰
3) 先行词中既有人又有物
4) 先行词被序数词或最高级修饰
5) 从句中套从句

knowledgePoints.title: 四、关系副词的用法
knowledgePoints.content: 关系副词在从句中作状语，相当于"介词+关系代词"

subPoints.title: when
subPoints.content:
先行词是表示时间的名词，when = on/in/at which
I still remember the day when I first came to Beijing.

subPoints.title: where
subPoints.content:
先行词是表示地点的名词，where = in/on/at which
Can you tell me the office where he works?

subPoints.title: why
subPoints.content:
先行词是reason，why = for which
I don't want to listen to any reason why you were absent.

knowledgePoints.title: 五、as引导的定语从句
knowledgePoints.content: as可以引导限制性和非限制性定语从句

subPoints.title: such...as...
subPoints.content: A computer is so useful a machine as we can use everyday.

subPoints.title: the same...as...
subPoints.content: He is not the same man as he was.

subPoints.title: as引导非限制性定语从句
subPoints.content:
As is well known to all, fish can't live without water.
As I remember, there were a net bar here.

exercises.question: The book ______ I bought yesterday is very interesting.
exercises.explanation: 先行词是book，指物，可以用which或that

exercises.question: He is the man ______ helped me yesterday.
exercises.explanation: 先行词是man，指人，在从句中作主语，用who或that

exercises.question: This is the best film ______ I have ever seen.
exercises.explanation: 先行词被最高级修饰，只能用that

exercises.question: The house ______ windows are broken is mine.
exercises.explanation: 表示房子的窗户，用whose作定语

exercises.question: I still remember the day ______ I first came to this school.
exercises.explanation: 先行词是day，表示时间，用when作时间状语

exercises.question: This is the factory ______ my father works.
exercises.explanation: 先行词是factory，表示地点，用where作地点状语

exercises.question: The reason ______ he was late is unknown.
exercises.explanation: 先行词是reason，用why作原因状语

exercises.question: He is such a kind teacher ______ we all love.
______ is well known, China is a developing country.
exercises.explanation: as引导非限制性定语从句，位于句首

exercises.question: The pen ______ you write is Jack's.
exercises.explanation: 介词之后只能用which，表示用这支笔写
